invite.title: Invite by email
invite.subtitleLeague: We email them a link to join the league
invite.subtitlePool: We email them a link to join the pool
invite.hint: If they don't have an account yet, the email walks them through creating one and the invitation is accepted right after.
invite.subtitleSurvivor: We email them a link to join the survivor

accept.signInBody: This invitation is for {email}. Sign in with that account to accept it.
accept.registerBody: There is no account for {email} yet. Create one and the invitation is accepted right after.
accept.wrongAccountBody: This invitation is for {email} and you are signed in as {current}.
accept.invalidBody: The invitation may have expired or the admin cancelled it. Ask them for a new one.
accept.closed: This league or pool already started, so the invitation may no longer be acceptable.
